full_judgment:
AK Badrul Huq J: In this country the habit, even if grief-stricken and unfortunate, yet it is a factuality quite common, now judicially recognized that people inimically bent towards the opponents, over the sad death of their near and dear one, do not hesitate in resorting to retribution to bring under indictment their antagonistic party. To put it differently, people do implicate innocent persons to satisfy their sense of revenge and to put the other side to utmost grief over the death of their near and dear one. There is a tendency to rope in good number of persons belonging to opposite camp for facing trial in respect of death of the victim of crime, sometimes inspired by over enthusiasm and many a time as designed efforts, to cause harassment to the blood relations and friends of the opponents. It has been noticed that on occasions innocent persons including the aged, infirm and children are booked for standing at the accused dock and remain incarcerated in prison till conclusion of trial. Some stand acquitted by Trial Court and some are liberated by Appellate Court but only after their languishing in jail for many years. Such strives on the part of unscrupulous survivors or the relatives of victim invariably but unfortunately, help the real offenders as it becomes difficult on the part of Court to separate grain from chaff. Under such circumstances and in view of prevalent Criminal Jurisprudential System in the country, the Doctrine of Presumption of Innocence in favour of accused renders Justice itself a victim which ultimately shatters Criminal Justice Dispensation System. It is, also, profitably posited that the statements made above are not the whole picture. Out of own blood there are some persons who do not want to bury truth into deep debris and they stand on witness box to speak the truth and to divulge true state of affairs in the Court of Law supplying materials before Court in regard to the incident. These criminal proceedings before this Court by way of appeals bestow an apt illustration how own blood of deceased divulged factuality in the Court and did not support the design perpetuated by other blood relations and other close relations of the deceased. 

 42. Cardinal Principle in our System of Administration of Justice for criminal cases is that a person arraigned as an accused is presumed to be innocent unless that presumption is rebutted by prosecution. Onus of proving everything essential to the establishment of charge against the accused lies upon prosecution which must prove the charge substantially as laid beyond all speck of doubt on the strength of clear, cogent, credible and unimpeachable evidence. Proof beyond reasonable doubt means proof of an offence with the certainty of criminal law, the certainty that an offence has been committed and no other person but the accused committed the offence. In appreciating the evidence of a prosecution witness, the approach must be whether the testimony of a witness carries a ring of truth or evidence is tainted with falsehood. Proof of charge must depend upon Judicial evaluation of the totality of evidence, oral and circumstantial and not by an isolated scrutiny. Prosecution version is, also, to be judged taking into account the overall circumstances of the case with a practical, pragmatic and reasonable approach in appreciation and assessment of the evidence let in to drive home the guilt of the accused person. In this context, it is conveniently emphasized that the fundamental principle of criminal law is that the boon of doubt arising out of any material point must be showered upon the person accused of a felony.
